notes.title: Patch 1.3 - Map changes and Bug Fixes
notes.content: Addressing map fixes and adding some enhancements! Also fixed a bug with alternate character sin the sandbox mode, you will no longer spawn in a wall :)

tags.bug: - Also fixed a bug with alternate character sin the sandbox mode, you will no longer spawn in a wall :)

notes.title: Patch 1.1 - Release Hotfixes
notes.content: Leaderboard fixes! Plus a hotfix for a server-based crash on run completion. If your game crashes after completing the game, your data will be saved so that the next time you open the app, you will be directed to the run submission page on the leaderboard.
